seo.title: Apple September 2026 — Apple Watch, explained
seo.description: Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4: the all-new Health Sensing System on the S11 chip, the daily Readiness score, 50-hour battery on the Ultra, and why the Ultra held its price.
seo.breakdown: the new heart sensor, the Readiness score, Ultra 4 battery, and the prices
seo.pinned: Series 12 or Ultra 4 — which one would you actually wear every day?
queries: what is new in Apple Watch Series 12
sources: apple.com/newsroom — Apple unveils Apple Watch Ultra 4

scenes.narration: The new Apple Watch reads your heart more often than any wearable Apple has built.

Welcome back. Apple announced two watches, and they share almost everything that matters. Today we're going through what the new sensor does, what the Ultra 4 buys you, and which one to get. So which watch is right for most people?

Start with the big one. Apple Watch Ultra 4 is a forty nine by forty four millimetre case in grade five titanium, twelve millimetres deep, with a flat sapphire front. The Action button sits on the left, where a gloved hand finds it, and the Crown and side button share the right edge. It's built for people who'll actually go somewhere with it.

appleStage.headline: Ultra 4: [49 by 44] millimetres
appleStage.caption: Grade 5 titanium, 12 mm deep
appleStage.premise: Case and display both to scale: 422 by 514 pixels at 326 ppi inside a 44 mm case.

scenes.narration: Series 12 is the smaller pair: forty six millimetres or forty two, in aluminium or titanium — and this year, in ceramic. Ceramic's the genuinely new one, and it's a millimetre taller and a fraction thicker than the metal cases because ceramic needs more material to survive a knock.

appleStage.headline: Series 12, now in [ceramic]
appleStage.caption: 46 mm or 42 mm
appleStage.premise: Aluminium, titanium and — new this year — ceramic, which runs 1 mm taller.

scenes.narration: Both watches lead on health, and Apple puts that first on its own page. Eight new health and fitness features across the pair, headed by a line about running with all your heart, which is closer to literal than it sounds, because what changed this year is the sensor itself rather than the software on top of it. Worth reading that section rather than the headline, and Apple spells it out further down.

recordedStep.sourceNote: Apple, Apple Watch Ultra 4 product page, captured 10 September 2026
recordedStep.caption: Eight new health features

scenes.narration: The detail sits further down, and that's the part worth reading. An all new Health Sensing System, working with the S11 chip, taking higher frequency heart readings. Larger, more power efficient green LEDs, so the watch can measure more often without spending the battery it used to.

recordedStep.sourceNote: Apple, Apple Watch Ultra 4 product page, captured 10 September 2026
recordedStep.caption: Higher-frequency heart monitoring

scenes.narration: That extra sampling pays off in one feature above the rest. The Vitals app now reads your recent activity, your sleep and your heart rate variability, and turns them into a single recent activity, your sleep and your heart rate variability, and turns them into a single daily readiness score: pace yourself, ready, or go for it. That works because the sensor now samples often enough to see a trend, which means one number on the face can answer the only question you actually have in the morning.

appleStage.headline: One number: [Readiness]
appleStage.caption: Pace Yourself · Ready · Go For It
appleStage.premise: Activity, sleep and heart rate variability, resolved into one score on the face.

scenes.narration: There's a second one that surprised me. You can run a proper mobility assessment by stepping in place in front of your iPhone camera, while the watch tracks your pace and form in real time. Two devices, one measurement — the kind of thing a lab used to charge you for.

appleStage.headline: A [VO2 max] test on your floor
appleStage.caption: Watch and iPhone, together
appleStage.premise: The watch measures pace and form; the iPhone camera watches you step in place.

cells.label: Two devices, one test
cells.sub: a lab used to charge for this

scenes.narration: Battery's where the Ultra 4 stops being a bigger Series 12. Fifty hours of everyday use, eighty four in low power, and ten hours of outdoor workout tracking, which is a quarter more than the last Ultra managed. That gap matters because a long workout is exactly when you can't stop to charge. Then there is the mode nobody else offers.

appleStage.headline: Ultra 4: [50 hours] everyday
appleStage.caption: Apple's stated figures
appleStage.premise: Everyday use, low power mode, and a tracked outdoor workout — three different numbers.

scenes.narration: Max Extended Workout mode tracks an outdoor run, walk or hike for forty five hours, still taking a GPS reading every second. Apple frames that as enough to finish a hundred mile race. And to be clear, that forty five is the Ultra's tracking figure — the other forty five you'll read about this month is the iPhone 18 Pro Max's video playback. Different products, one number.

appleStage.headline: [45 hours] of tracking, not playback
appleStage.caption: Max Extended Workout
appleStage.premise: Two different 45-hour claims landed this month. This one is the Ultra 4's GPS tracking.

scenes.narration: Both watches also get Siri AI on the wrist, and Apple gives it a section of its own. Audio Intelligence uses the built-in microphone and the S11 chip to make sense of what you hear around you, and the page is careful to say that happens privately, on the watch, because that's the obvious objection to a wearable that listens. Live Rewind catches the last thing somebody said, and Siri Recaps summarises a conversation you half missed, without keeping the raw audio.

recordedStep.sourceNote: Apple, Apple Watch Ultra 4 product page, captured 10 September 2026
recordedStep.caption: Audio Intelligence, on the watch

scenes.narration: Now the prices, and they matter more than usual this year. Series 12 starts at three ninety nine for the forty two millimetre aluminium, four forty nine for the forty six. Cellular adds a hundred, and titanium takes you to six ninety nine. Both go on sale on the eighteenth of September.

appleStage.headline: Series 12 from [$399]
appleStage.caption: US pricing
appleStage.premise: Apple's own tiers. The chip beside each row is its difference from the row above.

scenes.narration: And here's the part that got no headline. Apple Watch Ultra 4 costs seven ninety nine, which is exactly what the Ultra 3 cost. In a month where every older iPhone went up a hundred dollars, the Ultra held its price. So the honest advice is simple: buy the Series 12 unless you genuinely need the battery, because the sensor is the same in both.

appleStage.headline: The Ultra [held] its price
appleStage.caption: Against the rest of the launch
appleStage.premise: Ultra 4 is $799, the same as Ultra 3, in a month when every older iPhone rose $100.

scenes.narration: So: one sensor, two bodies, and a readiness score that is the reason to upgrade. AirPods are next, and after that the whole event in one go.
